errors.text_span: Für Deutschland weist Kupfer in den Jahren 2021, 2022 und 2023 Werte von 8,3 %, 11,4 % bzw. 11,3 % auf.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly swaps the values for 2022 and 2023 for Kupfer in Germany. The correct values are 8.3% (2021), 11.3% (2022), and 2.2% (2023), as shown in the figure.

errors.text_span: Für Nickel sind die Werte 2,2 %, 24,7 % und 25,1 %.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly swaps the values for 2021 and 2023 for Nickel in Germany. The correct values are 25.1% (2021), 24.7% (2022), and 11.4% (2023), as shown in the figure.

errors.text_span: Die Werte für Kupfer betragen 4,4 %, 5,1 % und 4,4 %.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly repeats the value 4.4% for Kupfer in the EU for 2023. The correct values are 4.4% (2021), 5.1% (2022), and 1.3% (2023), as shown in the figure.

errors.text_span: Für Nickel betragen die Werte 1,3 %, 23,3 % und 14,6 %.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly assigns the value 1.3% to Nickel in the EU for 2021. The correct values are 24.3% (2021), 23.3% (2022), and 14.6% (2023), as shown in the figure.
The machine description does not mention that the chart represents the share of Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials in percentage terms.
The machine description does not mention the color coding of the bars: blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and gray for 2023.
